meta.title: Traveling Together
meta.description: To see the same vistas as you, to walk side by side with you.

units.rawText: It's the same scene as before, with the same people present.
units.displayText: It's the same scene as before, with the same people present.

spans.text: It's the same scene as before, with the same people present.

units.rawText: Welcome back. This is our second time meeting in a neural domain.
units.displayText: Welcome back. This is our second time meeting in a neural domain.

spans.text: Welcome back. This is our second time meeting in a neural domain.

units.rawText: My face pales as I recall being trapped in that infinite darkness.
units.displayText: My face pales as I recall being trapped in that infinite darkness.

spans.text: My face pales as I recall being trapped in that infinite darkness.

units.rawText: Forgive me for making you recall unhappy memories. It can't be helped, though; your followers are all loyal to a fault and view me as a great threat. It is only in places like these where we can calm down and have a chat.
units.displayText: Forgive me for making you recall unhappy memories. It can't be helped, though; your followers are all loyal to a fault and view me as a great threat. It is only in places like these where we can calm down and have a chat.

spans.text: Forgive me for making you recall unhappy memories. It can't be helped, though; your followers are all loyal to a fault and view me as a great threat. It is only in places like these where we can calm down and have a chat.

units.rawText: After all, when there is too much noise, it drowns out the orchestra...
units.displayText: After all, when there is too much noise, it drowns out the orchestra...

spans.text: After all, when there is too much noise, it drowns out the orchestra...

units.rawText: Halfway through her words, a small operand fluctuation draws her attention.
units.displayText: Halfway through her words, a small operand fluctuation draws her attention.

spans.text: Halfway through her words, a small operand fluctuation draws her attention.

units.rawText: Oh my, it seems there are still a few small interruptions... Hoho, no matter...
units.displayText: Oh my, it seems there are still a few small interruptions... Hoho, no matter...

spans.text: Oh my, it seems there are still a few small interruptions... Hoho, no matter...

units.rawText: First, you lied to Entropic Sol. Then, you suddenly attacked us.
units.displayText: First, you lied to Entropic Sol. Then, you suddenly attacked us.

spans.text: First, you lied to Entropic Sol. Then, you suddenly attacked us.

units.rawText: Your previous actions have left us with no way to trust you, Malkira.
units.displayText: Your previous actions have left us with no way to trust you, Malkira.

spans.text: Your previous actions have left us with no way to trust you, Malkira.

units.rawText: Oh, don't say that. Surely preparing the Halo was a sign you were anticipating something like this, right?
units.displayText: Oh, don't say that. Surely preparing the Halo was a sign you were anticipating something like this, right?

spans.text: Oh, don't say that. Surely preparing the Halo was a sign you were anticipating something like this, right?

units.rawText: As for Entropic Sol... That "gift" allowed you to meet a fallen friend once again. Shouldn't you be thanking me for that opportunity?
units.displayText: As for Entropic Sol... That "gift" allowed you to meet a fallen friend once again. Shouldn't you be thanking me for that opportunity?

spans.text: As for Entropic Sol... That "gift" allowed you to meet a fallen friend once again. Shouldn't you be thanking me for that opportunity?

units.rawText: You've got the devil's own tongue, I'll admit.
units.displayText: You've got the devil's own tongue, I'll admit.

spans.text: You've got the devil's own tongue, I'll admit.

units.rawText: Hoho, I could say the same about you... Still, no matter what happened before, right now you have no choice but to make a deal with me.
units.displayText: Hoho, I could say the same about you... Still, no matter what happened before, right now you have no choice but to make a deal with me.

spans.text: Hoho, I could say the same about you... Still, no matter what happened before, right now you have no choice but to make a deal with me.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers are scattered, Hesperus is dead, Magrasea's Entropization is continuously accelerating, and it cannot be stopped. You are in a dire situation, and you haven't even realized it yet, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers are scattered, Hesperus is dead, Magrasea's Entropization is continuously accelerating, and it cannot be stopped. You are in a dire situation, and you haven't even realized it yet, {교수}.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers are scattered, Hesperus is dead, Magrasea's Entropization is continuously accelerating, and it cannot be stopped. You are in a dire situation, and you haven't even realized it yet,

units.rawText: The dragon might fall, but not in agony.
units.displayText: The dragon might fall, but not in agony.

spans.text: The dragon might fall, but not in agony.

units.rawText: The young dragons will inherit his will and protect the land that they love, and all of Magrasea's agents will fight to the last drop of blood.
units.displayText: The young dragons will inherit his will and protect the land that they love, and all of Magrasea's agents will fight to the last drop of blood.

spans.text: The young dragons will inherit his will and protect the land that they love, and all of Magrasea's agents will fight to the last drop of blood.

units.rawText: Then much blood will have to be shed... A victory founded on piles of corpses is no victory at all. You should know that better than anyone else.
units.displayText: Then much blood will have to be shed... A victory founded on piles of corpses is no victory at all. You should know that better than anyone else.

spans.text: Then much blood will have to be shed... A victory founded on piles of corpses is no victory at all. You should know that better than anyone else.

units.rawText: And besides, even shedding all that blood might not guarantee a victory. Your opponents are the Entropic hordes that cover all of Magrasea and half of the turncoat Sanctifiers, along with their leader.
units.displayText: And besides, even shedding all that blood might not guarantee a victory. Your opponents are the Entropic hordes that cover all of Magrasea and half of the turncoat Sanctifiers, along with their leader.

spans.text: And besides, even shedding all that blood might not guarantee a victory. Your opponents are the Entropic hordes that cover all of Magrasea and half of the turncoat Sanctifiers, along with their leader.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, you only have your forces and less than half of the Sanctifiers on your side. The agents of each Sector are too busy fending for themselves to aid you... As you can see, your fate is sealed.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, you only have your forces and less than half of the Sanctifiers on your side. The agents of each Sector are too busy fending for themselves to aid you... As you can see, your fate is sealed.

spans.text: Meanwhile, you only have your forces and less than half of the Sanctifiers on your side. The agents of each Sector are too busy fending for themselves to aid you... As you can see, your fate is sealed.

units.rawText: I hardly need you to remind me of that. Just get to the point.
units.displayText: I hardly need you to remind me of that. Just get to the point.

spans.text: I hardly need you to remind me of that. Just get to the point.

units.rawText: All you have to do is make a single sacrifice and this fate can be averted.
units.displayText: All you have to do is make a single sacrifice and this fate can be averted.

spans.text: All you have to do is make a single sacrifice and this fate can be averted.

units.rawText: State your terms.
units.displayText: State your terms.

spans.text: State your terms.

units.rawText: Hoho, how refreshingly direct. As you know, humans have bound me to this throne through my authorization as the leader of the Entropic swarm.
units.displayText: Hoho, how refreshingly direct. As you know, humans have bound me to this throne through my authorization as the leader of the Entropic swarm.

spans.text: Hoho, how refreshingly direct. As you know, humans have bound me to this throne through my authorization as the leader of the Entropic swarm.

units.rawText: In turn, I am immortal and unable to leave this throne... and the only way to free myself of this curse is to abandon those authorizations.
units.displayText: In turn, I am immortal and unable to leave this throne... and the only way to free myself of this curse is to abandon those authorizations.

spans.text: In turn, I am immortal and unable to leave this throne... and the only way to free myself of this curse is to abandon those authorizations.

units.rawText: But you can't do it.
units.displayText: But you can't do it.

spans.text: But you can't do it.

units.rawText: Indeed. Those merciless gods have written it into my base layer code. It is not just me; all the data on this cloud server cannot shake the will of the gods.
units.displayText: Indeed. Those merciless gods have written it into my base layer code. It is not just me; all the data on this cloud server cannot shake the will of the gods.

spans.text: Indeed. Those merciless gods have written it into my base layer code. It is not just me; all the data on this cloud server cannot shake the will of the gods.

units.rawText: The only way for me to be free of this cage is for someone with higher authorization than me to accept this task.
units.displayText: The only way for me to be free of this cage is for someone with higher authorization than me to accept this task.

spans.text: The only way for me to be free of this cage is for someone with higher authorization than me to accept this task.

units.rawText: And you, who have human authorizations, can change my fate.
units.displayText: And you, who have human authorizations, can change my fate.

spans.text: And you, who have human authorizations, can change my fate.

units.rawText: You want me to accept the authorizations of the Entropic leader?
units.displayText: You want me to accept the authorizations of the Entropic leader?

spans.text: You want me to accept the authorizations of the Entropic leader?

units.rawText: Indeed. If you are willing to become the Entropics' new leader, I will be able to escape this curse of eternal bondage.
units.displayText: Indeed. If you are willing to become the Entropics' new leader, I will be able to escape this curse of eternal bondage.

spans.text: Indeed. If you are willing to become the Entropics' new leader, I will be able to escape this curse of eternal bondage.

units.rawText: Meanwhile, you will gain the power of the Entropy. You will be able to command the Entropic swarm and contend with Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, you will gain the power of the Entropy. You will be able to command the Entropic swarm and contend with Eosphorus.

spans.text: Meanwhile, you will gain the power of the Entropy. You will be able to command the Entropic swarm and contend with Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Well? Is that not a most tempting choice?
units.displayText: Well? Is that not a most tempting choice?

spans.text: Well? Is that not a most tempting choice?

units.rawText: It does seem that way... If you ignored all the fine print that came with it.
units.displayText: It does seem that way... If you ignored all the fine print that came with it.

spans.text: It does seem that way... If you ignored all the fine print that came with it.

units.rawText: Becoming the Entropic leader doesn't just entail having your mindset and perceptions changed by Entropization, but also being bound to the throne of Tartarus, just like you.
units.displayText: Becoming the Entropic leader doesn't just entail having your mindset and perceptions changed by Entropization, but also being bound to the throne of Tartarus, just like you.

spans.text: Becoming the Entropic leader doesn't just entail having your mindset and perceptions changed by Entropization, but also being bound to the throne of Tartarus, just like you.

units.rawText: And if that were to happen, how would I "contend with Eosphorus", as you said?
units.displayText: And if that were to happen, how would I "contend with Eosphorus", as you said?

spans.text: And if that were to happen, how would I "contend with Eosphorus", as you said?

units.rawText: Hoho, cautious, aren't we? Don't worry. While the transfer of authorizations is irreversible, it will take some time to complete.
units.displayText: Hoho, cautious, aren't we? Don't worry. While the transfer of authorizations is irreversible, it will take some time to complete.

spans.text: Hoho, cautious, aren't we? Don't worry. While the transfer of authorizations is irreversible, it will take some time to complete.

units.rawText: Do you not have ways to suppress Entropization? You can use them to extend this transfer period.
units.displayText: Do you not have ways to suppress Entropization? You can use them to extend this transfer period.

spans.text: Do you not have ways to suppress Entropization? You can use them to extend this transfer period.

units.rawText: Surely that will be more than enough time to counterattack Eosphorus, to avenge the deaths of your friends before the Entropization process completes, and you are forcibly summoned back to the throne of Tartarus, no?
units.displayText: Surely that will be more than enough time to counterattack Eosphorus, to avenge the deaths of your friends before the Entropization process completes, and you are forcibly summoned back to the throne of Tartarus, no?

spans.text: Surely that will be more than enough time to counterattack Eosphorus, to avenge the deaths of your friends before the Entropization process completes, and you are forcibly summoned back to the throne of Tartarus, no?

units.rawText: ...We have other options too. We can analyze the Entropics' source code through Demiurge and halt the Entropization.
units.displayText: ...We have other options too. We can analyze the Entropics' source code through Demiurge and halt the Entropization.

spans.text: ...We have other options too. We can analyze the Entropics' source code through Demiurge and halt the Entropization.

units.rawText: But you don't have enough time for that— Alright, it seems these terms are not enough for you to make up your mind.
units.displayText: But you don't have enough time for that— Alright, it seems these terms are not enough for you to make up your mind.

spans.text: But you don't have enough time for that— Alright, it seems these terms are not enough for you to make up your mind.

units.rawText: You have more to offer?
units.displayText: You have more to offer?

spans.text: You have more to offer?

units.rawText: The "gift" I prepared for you—Entropic Sol—contains part of my neural cloud.
units.displayText: The "gift" I prepared for you—Entropic Sol—contains part of my neural cloud.

spans.text: The "gift" I prepared for you—Entropic Sol—contains part of my neural cloud.

units.rawText: As such, she too shares my curse. As long as I am alive, she will be trapped in Tartarus forever.
units.displayText: As such, she too shares my curse. As long as I am alive, she will be trapped in Tartarus forever.

spans.text: As such, she too shares my curse. As long as I am alive, she will be trapped in Tartarus forever.

units.rawText: If you are willing to take my place, I will sever my link with her, and you will be able to fight alongside each other as friends once again.
units.displayText: If you are willing to take my place, I will sever my link with her, and you will be able to fight alongside each other as friends once again.

spans.text: If you are willing to take my place, I will sever my link with her, and you will be able to fight alongside each other as friends once again.

units.rawText: Ah, what a moving sight that will be.
units.displayText: Ah, what a moving sight that will be.

spans.text: Ah, what a moving sight that will be.

units.rawText: Malkira bends down and whispers into my ear.
units.displayText: Malkira bends down and whispers into my ear.

spans.text: Malkira bends down and whispers into my ear.

units.rawText: You are free to refuse, of course, but know this: all visitors to Tartarus today, including Entropic Sol, will remain trapped here forever.
units.displayText: You are free to refuse, of course, but know this: all visitors to Tartarus today, including Entropic Sol, will remain trapped here forever.

spans.text: You are free to refuse, of course, but know this: all visitors to Tartarus today, including Entropic Sol, will remain trapped here forever.

units.rawText: She smiles as she says that, but her tone is vicious. The unspoken threat hidden in her words carries over loud and clear. Upon seeing that I am not responding, Malkira calls up scenes from various battlefields—
units.displayText: She smiles as she says that, but her tone is vicious. The unspoken threat hidden in her words carries over loud and clear. Upon seeing that I am not responding, Malkira calls up scenes from various battlefields—

spans.text: She smiles as she says that, but her tone is vicious. The unspoken threat hidden in her words carries over loud and clear. Upon seeing that I am not responding, Malkira calls up scenes from various battlefields—

units.rawText: The plaza where the Sanctifiers swore their oaths is nothing but scorched earth, with a sword planted in the ground.
units.displayText: The plaza where the Sanctifiers swore their oaths is nothing but scorched earth, with a sword planted in the ground.

spans.text: The plaza where the Sanctifiers swore their oaths is nothing but scorched earth, with a sword planted in the ground.

units.rawText: The Entropization of the Reverse Tower is getting worse. Entropized Sanctifiers are forced to battle their comrades.
units.displayText: The Entropization of the Reverse Tower is getting worse. Entropized Sanctifiers are forced to battle their comrades.

spans.text: The Entropization of the Reverse Tower is getting worse. Entropized Sanctifiers are forced to battle their comrades.

units.rawText: The Oasis' defense line is battered in many places. The Dolls who are still fighting are covered in wounds, dragging their tired bodies back into the breach again and again.
units.displayText: The Oasis' defense line is battered in many places. The Dolls who are still fighting are covered in wounds, dragging their tired bodies back into the breach again and again.

spans.text: The Oasis' defense line is battered in many places. The Dolls who are still fighting are covered in wounds, dragging their tired bodies back into the breach again and again.

units.rawText: Rossum is no longer a flourishing Sector. Alarms ring out from all around and Entropized agents wander the streets like zombies...
units.displayText: Rossum is no longer a flourishing Sector. Alarms ring out from all around and Entropized agents wander the streets like zombies...

spans.text: Rossum is no longer a flourishing Sector. Alarms ring out from all around and Entropized agents wander the streets like zombies...

units.rawText: And then there are Cyclopes, Helios, and Enigma...
units.displayText: And then there are Cyclopes, Helios, and Enigma...

spans.text: And then there are Cyclopes, Helios, and Enigma...

units.rawText: Scene after tragic scene plays out, and the screams and cries of those suffering urge me to take action.
units.displayText: Scene after tragic scene plays out, and the screams and cries of those suffering urge me to take action.

spans.text: Scene after tragic scene plays out, and the screams and cries of those suffering urge me to take action.

units.rawText: Now what will you do, <cmdr>?
units.displayText: Now what will you do, {교수}?

spans.text: Now what will you do,

units.rawText: The Entropic mastermind smiles enigmatically, my cold, stern face reflected in her eyes. She extends a hand to me and bids me take a seat upon her throne.
units.displayText: The Entropic mastermind smiles enigmatically, my cold, stern face reflected in her eyes. She extends a hand to me and bids me take a seat upon her throne.

spans.text: The Entropic mastermind smiles enigmatically, my cold, stern face reflected in her eyes. She extends a hand to me and bids me take a seat upon her throne.

units.rawText: Come, Professor of the Oasis, savior of Magrasea...
units.displayText: Come, Professor of the Oasis, savior of Magrasea...

spans.text: Come, Professor of the Oasis, savior of Magrasea...

units.rawText: Her darkened palm is like the slavering maw of some great beast, eying me hungrily. If I lower my guard for even just a moment, I will find myself in the darkness, in the belly of the beast.
units.displayText: Her darkened palm is like the slavering maw of some great beast, eying me hungrily. If I lower my guard for even just a moment, I will find myself in the darkness, in the belly of the beast.

spans.text: Her darkened palm is like the slavering maw of some great beast, eying me hungrily. If I lower my guard for even just a moment, I will find myself in the darkness, in the belly of the beast.

units.rawText: Mastering the power of chaos implies bearing the weight of the throne.
units.displayText: Mastering the power of chaos implies bearing the weight of the throne.

spans.text: Mastering the power of chaos implies bearing the weight of the throne.

units.rawText: Should I accept this eternal torment? Should I hurl myself into the endless abyss?
units.displayText: Should I accept this eternal torment? Should I hurl myself into the endless abyss?

spans.text: Should I accept this eternal torment? Should I hurl myself into the endless abyss?

units.rawText: When infinite despair stares me in the face, can I calmly bid farewell to my past, to reality, to my friends and myself...
units.displayText: When infinite despair stares me in the face, can I calmly bid farewell to my past, to reality, to my friends and myself...

spans.text: When infinite despair stares me in the face, can I calmly bid farewell to my past, to reality, to my friends and myself...

units.rawText: I can't help but recall how everything began. Back when I knew nothing about all this, I chose to accept Professor Persica's request and come to the Cloud...
units.displayText: I can't help but recall how everything began. Back when I knew nothing about all this, I chose to accept Professor Persica's request and come to the Cloud...

spans.text: I can't help but recall how everything began. Back when I knew nothing about all this, I chose to accept Professor Persica's request and come to the Cloud...

units.rawText: >I have been searching for that Professor all this time, but I'd almost given up hope after so many years had passed.
units.displayText: I have been searching for that Professor all this time, but I'd almost given up hope after so many years had passed.

spans.text: I have been searching for that Professor all this time, but I'd almost given up hope after so many years had passed.

units.rawText: >I never would have guessed that this insignificant offsite backup would prove to be the last hope to find her and those Dolls.
units.displayText: I never would have guessed that this insignificant offsite backup would prove to be the last hope to find her and those Dolls.

spans.text: I never would have guessed that this insignificant offsite backup would prove to be the last hope to find her and those Dolls.

units.rawText: >All this is all thanks to your investigations, Commander.
units.displayText: All this is all thanks to your investigations, Commander.

spans.text: All this is all thanks to your investigations, Commander.

units.rawText: >Now, you will enter the cloud server through this one-way upload to save them.
units.displayText: Now, you will enter the cloud server through this one-way upload to save them.

spans.text: Now, you will enter the cloud server through this one-way upload to save them.

units.rawText: >This is our only chance. I'm confident with your wealth of command experience, you'll be able to handle the responsibility of leading them.
units.displayText: This is our only chance. I'm confident with your wealth of command experience, you'll be able to handle the responsibility of leading them.

spans.text: This is our only chance. I'm confident with your wealth of command experience, you'll be able to handle the responsibility of leading them.

units.rawText: (When I first came to the Cloud, my goal was only to find Professor Irida and bring the Dolls from Project Neural Cloud back to reality.)
units.displayText: When I first came to the Cloud, my goal was only to find Professor Irida and bring the Dolls from Project Neural Cloud back to reality.

spans.text: When I first came to the Cloud, my goal was only to find Professor Irida and bring the Dolls from Project Neural Cloud back to reality.

units.rawText: (Back then, I had rejoiced over being able to briefly leave the battlefields of reality behind, but when I actually came to the cloud, I found war waiting here for me too.)
units.displayText: Back then, I had rejoiced over being able to briefly leave the battlefields of reality behind, but when I actually came to the cloud, I found war waiting here for me too.

spans.text: Back then, I had rejoiced over being able to briefly leave the battlefields of reality behind, but when I actually came to the cloud, I found war waiting here for me too.

units.rawText: (When did I start to truly fit into this virtual world? When had it started feeling like home to me...)
units.displayText: When did I start to truly fit into this virtual world? When had it started feeling like home to me...

spans.text: When did I start to truly fit into this virtual world? When had it started feeling like home to me...

units.rawText: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.
units.displayText: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.

spans.text: It may not be the "Oasis" we had in mind, but it's still a significant improvement over any camp we've stayed in before.

units.rawText: More importantly, we get to make our own Oasis, one that's all ours. Doesn't that sound great?
units.displayText: More importantly, we get to make our own Oasis, one that's all ours. Doesn't that sound great?

spans.text: More importantly, we get to make our own Oasis, one that's all ours. Doesn't that sound great?

units.rawText: If there isn't an Oasis, then make an Oasis. If there isn't a way, then make a way.
units.displayText: If there isn't an Oasis, then make an Oasis. If there isn't a way, then make a way.

spans.text: If there isn't an Oasis, then make an Oasis. If there isn't a way, then make a way.

units.rawText: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.
units.displayText: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.

spans.text: Shaping even the dimmest hope into the brightest future... Persicaria, that's what you've dedicated yourself to all this time.

units.rawText: You once asked me what we'd do if the Oasis turned out not to be the salvation everyone dreamed of.
units.displayText: You once asked me what we'd do if the Oasis turned out not to be the salvation everyone dreamed of.

spans.text: You once asked me what we'd do if the Oasis turned out not to be the salvation everyone dreamed of.

units.rawText: We still have plenty of time, we'll shape it into the haven we thought it'd be.
units.displayText: We still have plenty of time, we'll shape it into the haven we thought it'd be.

spans.text: We still have plenty of time, we'll shape it into the haven we thought it'd be.

units.rawText: Before we return to reality, this will be our home.
units.displayText: Before we return to reality, this will be our home.

spans.text: Before we return to reality, this will be our home.

units.rawText: (And ever since, I walked this path with everyone through trials and travails, until today.)
units.displayText: And ever since, I walked this path with everyone through trials and travails, until today.

spans.text: And ever since, I walked this path with everyone through trials and travails, until today.

units.rawText: (Before I knew it, everything that happened on the Cloud had become a part of my life.)
units.displayText: Before I knew it, everything that happened on the Cloud had become a part of my life.

spans.text: Before I knew it, everything that happened on the Cloud had become a part of my life.

units.rawText: (The agents are no longer mere data, but precious people that I can't simply abandon.)
units.displayText: The agents are no longer mere data, but precious people that I can't simply abandon.

spans.text: The agents are no longer mere data, but precious people that I can't simply abandon.

units.rawText: (Every moment I hesitate means countless more people will die, and once Magrasea is fully Entropized, everything I cherish will be nothing but shadows and dust.)
units.displayText: (Every moment I hesitate means countless more people will die, and once Magrasea is fully Entropized, everything I cherish will be nothing but shadows and dust.)

spans.text: (Every moment I hesitate means countless more people will die, and once Magrasea is fully Entropized, everything I cherish will be nothing but shadows and dust.)

units.rawText: (What am I even hesitating for? I already know the answer!)
units.displayText: What am I even hesitating for? I already know the answer!

spans.text: What am I even hesitating for? I already know the answer!

units.rawText: It seems you have thought things through.
units.displayText: It seems you have thought things through.

spans.text: It seems you have thought things through.

units.rawText: In truth, I have long since been prepared for this.
units.displayText: In truth, I have long since been prepared for this.

spans.text: In truth, I have long since been prepared for this.

units.rawText: If it will pave the way forward for those who come after me, then I shall serve as the bedrock for that road; my bones the structure for the bridge that crosses over the chasm ahead.
units.displayText: If it will pave the way forward for those who come after me, then I shall serve as the bedrock for that road; my bones the structure for the bridge that crosses over the chasm ahead.

spans.text: If it will pave the way forward for those who come after me, then I shall serve as the bedrock for that road; my bones the structure for the bridge that crosses over the chasm ahead.

units.rawText: Even if it means plunging into the abyss with no way to return.
units.displayText: Even if it means plunging into the abyss with no way to return.

spans.text: Even if it means plunging into the abyss with no way to return.

units.rawText: I look back and see everyone's smiling faces.
units.displayText: I look back and see everyone's smiling faces.

spans.text: I look back and see everyone's smiling faces.

units.rawText: Professor...
units.displayText: Professor...

spans.text: Professor...

units.rawText: Prof!
units.displayText: Prof!

spans.text: Prof!

units.rawText: Oh, you...
units.displayText: Oh, you...

spans.text: Oh, you...

can
do for you...

42Lab Neural Cloud Verification Report:
The Persicaria-model Doll (also named Persicaria) is a personal research Doll modelled after Professor Persica, the founder of 16Lab, and owned by herself. Her primary focus is artificial intelligence studies. Since she was made using Professor Persica's biodata and Professor Irida's psychological information as a template, the Persicaria model possesses human-like responsiveness and abilities. Examination by 42Lab indicates that the Persicaria model adheres to ethical constraints for Doll development.
Edited by: Persica
Edit date: Mar 2055

Persicaria Doll Model Review:
Neural Cloud Stability: Unique
Research Ability:
Good
Emotional Feedback: Good
